QuestInfo.name: [New Year Event] Fun Maple Game of Yut
QuestInfo.0: Happy New Years!\nCast the Yut Sticks to accumulate points and earn some #r#t02430662##k!
QuestInfo.1: Happy New Years!\nCast the Yut Sticks to accumulate points and earn some #r#t02430662##k!
QuestInfo.2:
Hunt monsters to obtain Yut Sticks.

Yut Sticks are worth one to five points a piece. Trade 200 points for a #r#t02430662##k.

Only monsters less than 11 levels below or 21 levels above you will drop Yut Sticks!

0.0: Celebrate the new year with the traditional Korean game of Yut. All you have to do is beat up monsters and collect the sticks they drop. Are you interested?

no.0: Let me know if you're interested in the game of Yut!

yes.0: Cool! But you gotta get the pieces because I am NOT paying for shipping. Monsters usually have #i2430659# #rYut Sticks#k on them. There are a few different kinds of Yut Sticks, but they'll give #bbetween one and five points#k.
yes.2: Your points will reset when you come turn them in, but I'll keep track of your #rtotal accumulated points#k. Get #r5000 total#k and I'll give you an #bEvent Stamp#k, because I am the raddest chick on the planet.\n\n
yes.3: Oh, and as usual, monsters that are #b11 levels lower or 21 levels higher than you will not have Yut Sticks#k!
yes.1: The best ones are the Yut or the Mo. Hehe, that's fun to say!\n\nCollect as many Yut Sticks as you can and bring them back to me! I'll give you a #bNew Year's Gift Box#k for #revery 200 points#k!

default.0: Did you have fun? Talk to Cassandra when you have 200 points!
